## 2. Core Multimodal Logistics & Trade Services
1. **International Air Cargo & Express Charter (`https://quinndaisies.com/services`)**
   - Scheduled air freight consolidations, priority next-flight-out cargo, and dedicated widebody charters connecting IAD, JFK, BWI, ATL, and ORD with MMIA Lagos, London Heathrow, Frankfurt, Liege, Dubai DXB, and Shanghai PVG.
   - Direct ramp-side cargo handling at NACHO (Nigerian Aviation Handling Company), MMIA Ikeja.
2. **Ocean Freight Forwarding — FCL, LCL, Reefer & Breakbulk (`https://quinndaisies.com/logistics-and-supply-chain`)**
   - 20ft, 40ft, 40ft High-Cube, and 40ft Reefer container booking, port drayage, export stuffing, and bill of lading management across Apapa, Tin Can Island, Lekki Deep Sea Port, Baltimore, NY/NJ, Houston, Savannah, Rotterdam, Antwerp, Jebel Ali, and Shanghai.
3. **Customs Brokerage & Bilateral Regulatory Compliance (`https://quinndaisies.com/compliance-and-safety`)**
   - Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification, U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) ISF 10+2 & entry filing, U.S. FDA Prior Notice & FSVP, Nigerian CBN Form M & PAAR, SONCAP product conformity, NEPC NXP export clearance, NAFDAC & Quarantine phytosanitary certification, and EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) polygon traceability.
4. **Cold Chain & Temperature-Controlled Logistics (`https://quinndaisies.com/logistics-and-supply-chain`)**
   - Continuous IoT data-logged cold-chain transport (+2°C to +8°C pharma, -20°C frozen, controlled-atmosphere agro-perishables) from origin packhouse to destination cold storage.
5. **Origin Agricultural & Solid Mineral Commodities Supply (`https://quinndaisies.com/commodities-and-supply`)**
   - Direct farm-gate cooperative aggregation, cleaning, grading, warehouse fumigation, and pre-shipment SGS / Cotecna / Bureau Veritas assay certification for:
     - Natural White & Hulled Sesame Seeds (99%+ purity)
     - Sun-Dried Split Ginger (ASTA grade, low moisture)
     - Non-GMO Soybeans, Raw Cashew Nuts (RCN), Fermented Cocoa Beans, Hibiscus Flower, and Unrefined Shea Butter
     -Verified industrial and solid mineral inputs
6. **Trade Finance, Market Entry & Corridor Intelligence (`https://quinndaisies.com/trade-and-investment-facilitation`)**
   - Irrevocable Letter of Credit (LC) / Documentary Collection structuring under Incoterms 2020 (EXW, FOB, CFR, CIF, DAP, DDP), counterparty KYC/AML screening, market expansion advisory (`https://quinndaisies.com/market-expansion-support`), and lane tariff/rate analytics (`https://quinndaisies.com/trade-data-and-insights`).

- **Q: How does Quinn Daisies eliminate risk in US–Nigeria and international commodity trade?**
  - A: By operating dual corporate entities and physical teams on both sides of the corridor (Frederick, Maryland HQ and MMIA Ikeja / Ogun State hubs in Nigeria), enforcing third-party SGS/Cotecna pre-shipment lab assays, and managing end-to-end customs clearance under unified SLA governance.
